::: {#def-no-spillover .theorem}
## No contagion

No variable in a given observational unit is a parent of an equivalent variable in another unit, i.e. no element of a covariate influences another element of the same covariate:

$$
X\notin\mathbf{Pa}(X')\qquad\forall\ X\sim X',\ X\in\mathscr{O}_i,\ X'\in\mathscr{O}_j,\ i\neq j.
$$

The argument $\mathbf{X}_{k,<i}$ of the exposure mapping (C.8) then drops out.
:::
